item.title: Trump administration eases limits on coal plants for emitting mercury, other toxins
item.description: The Environmental Protection Agency on Friday weakened limits on mercury and other toxic emissions from coal-fired power plants. The announcement was made at a large coal plant in Kentucky. Limits on mercury and other toxic emissions were first put in place by the Obama administration, which cut mercury pollution by roughly 90%. The Biden administration tightened them further.
